## `client.saved_queries`

Saved queries: SQL kept under a name, private or shared with the environment.

A saved query is text and an environment. Running it is an ordinary query (`client.queries.submit`) by whoever runs it, with their own rights.

### `client.saved_queries.list`

Signature: `client.saved_queries.list(environment: str | None = None, *, limit: int = 50, cursor: str | None = None) -> SavedQueryPage`

List one page of the saved queries you see, by name.

You see your own, the shared ones (``everyone``) of an environment where you may submit queries, and, as an instance administrator, every one; an administrator sees the SQL of someone else's private query only with `READ_QUERY_TEXT`. Without `environment`, the list spans every environment you may query.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `str | None` | `None` | Only this environment; `None` for every environment. |
| `limit` | `int` | `50` | Most items returned (1 to 200). |
| `cursor` | `str | None` | `None` | A previous page's `next_cursor` of the same list. |

Returns: `SavedQueryPage`. The saved queries, and the cursor of the next page (`None` on the last).

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.PermissionDenied` | With `environment`, if you may not query it and own no saved query there. |
| `lakana.NotFound` | With `environment`, if it does not exist. |
| `lakana.ValidationError` | If `limit` is outside 1 to 200, or `cursor` is not one the server issued for this list. |

### `client.saved_queries.iter`

Signature: `client.saved_queries.iter(environment: str | None = None) -> Iterator[SavedQuery]`

Yield every saved query you see, fetching pages as needed.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `str | None` | `None` | Only this environment; `None` for every environment. |

Yields: `SavedQuery`. Each saved query, once, in the order of `list`.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.PermissionDenied` | As `list`. |
| `lakana.NotFound` | As `list`. |

### `client.saved_queries.create`

Signature: `client.saved_queries.create(environment: str, name: str, sql: str, *, visibility: str = 'private') -> SavedQuery`

Save a query under your name in an environment.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `str` | required | The environment; you need `SUBMIT_QUERY` there. |
| `name` | `str` | required | The name: one line of 1 to 200 visible characters, unique among your saved queries in the environment. |
| `sql` | `str` | required | The SQL, stored as sent; not empty, and no longer than the server's statement limit. |
| `visibility` | `str` | `'private'` | ``private`` (only you) or ``everyone`` (whoever may query the environment). |

Returns: `SavedQuery`. The saved query.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.PermissionDenied` | If you may not submit queries in the environment, or use a task token. |
| `lakana.NotFound` | If the environment does not exist. |
| `lakana.Conflict` | If you already have a saved query of this name there; the sentence names its id. |
| `lakana.ValidationError` | If the name or the SQL is not allowed, or `visibility` is unknown. |

### `client.saved_queries.get`

Signature: `client.saved_queries.get(environment: str, saved_query_id: str) -> SavedQuery`

Read one saved query.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `str` | required | The environment. |
| `saved_query_id` | `str` | required | The saved query's id. |

Returns: `SavedQuery`. The saved query; its `sql` is `None` when you may not read it.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.NotFound` | If there is no such saved query that you see. |
| `lakana.PermissionDenied` | For a task token. |

### `client.saved_queries.update`

Signature: `client.saved_queries.update(environment: str, saved_query_id: str, *, name: str, sql: str, visibility: str) -> SavedQuery`

Replace a saved query's name, SQL and visibility; only its owner may.

The call replaces every field: read the saved query first to keep one as it is.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `str` | required | The environment. |
| `saved_query_id` | `str` | required | The saved query's id. |
| `name` | `str` | required | The new name, as in `create`. |
| `sql` | `str` | required | The new SQL, as in `create`. |
| `visibility` | `str` | required | ``private`` or ``everyone``. |

Returns: `SavedQuery`. The saved query as changed.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.NotFound` | If there is no such saved query that you see. |
| `lakana.PermissionDenied` | If you are not the owner, or no longer hold `SUBMIT_QUERY` in the environment. |
| `lakana.Conflict` | If you already have another saved query of this name there. |
| `lakana.ValidationError` | If the name or the SQL is not allowed. |

### `client.saved_queries.delete`

Signature: `client.saved_queries.delete(environment: str, saved_query_id: str) -> None`

Delete a saved query; its owner or an administrator may.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `str` | required | The environment. |
| `saved_query_id` | `str` | required | The saved query's id. |

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.NotFound` | If there is no such saved query that you see. |
| `lakana.PermissionDenied` | If you are neither its owner nor an administrator. |
